deviations.note: What a user reads is German: UI text and the user guide docs/benutzung.md; keys, identifiers, comments, the rest of docs/, tests and commits stay English. Ends once a second source brings users who do not read German. Recorded in the Deviations table of AGENTS.md.

CashPrism.TestSupport is a second project without a .Unit/.Integration suffix that belongs to no production project. It holds fixtures used by at least two test projects and contains no tests. Recorded in the Deviations table of AGENTS.md.

Maintenance scripts under .devkit/ carry no unit tests; a gate that runs the script end to end covers it instead. Applies to .devkit/generate-third-party-notices.cs, covered by the notices gate. Recorded in the Deviations table of AGENTS.md.

The setup code for the first password is printed in the start banner and therefore reaches the container log. Random per start, worthless once a password is set. Recorded in the Deviations table of AGENTS.md; decided in issue #123.

Recorded in the Deviations table of AGENTS.md; decided in issue #214.
